question: On 12 February 2023, the President of India appointed the Governor of states. Which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option** **3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **S Abdul Nazeer** was appointed as the Governor of Andhra Pradesh on **February 12, 2023**.
 
• The role of governors in India includes being the constitutional head of a state and overseeing its legislative assembly.
 
• **Ramesh Baish **is the Governor of Maharashtra.
 
• **Phagu Chauhan** is the Governor of Meghalaya.
 
• **Shiv Pratap Shukla** is the Governor of Himachal Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 153** states that there shall be a **Governor **for each **state**. This establishes the role of the governor as a constitutional authority.
 
• Governors are appointed by the President of India, as per** Article 155**, which empowers the **President **to appoint **governors **at their discretion.
 
• While governors typically serve a term of **five years**, they hold office at the pleasure of the **President**, meaning they can be removed at any time.
 
• Governors have various powers, including **legislative**, **executive**, and **judicial functions**, and they play a key role in the state government’s functioning, including the ability to summon and prorogue the state legislature.
